def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    stocks = 500000
    fixed_income = 330000
    house_value = 350000
    present_value_earnings = 980000

    mortgage = 175000
    future_consumption = 870000
    college_tuition = 150000
    family_foundation = 600000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_economic_assets = (
        stocks
        + fixed_income
        + house_value
        + present_value_earnings
    )

    total_economic_liabilities = (
        mortgage
        + future_consumption
        + college_tuition
        + family_foundation
    )

    economic_net_worth = total_economic_assets - total_economic_liabilities

    # Return the answer to a single decimal place
    return round(economic_net_worth, 1)
